data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Nujud is derived from the root 'n-j-d', meaning 'to be apparent, to become visible'. In the Islamic context, it is often used to describe the manifestation or evidence of God's presence or divine will. The name Nujud carries the meaning “Manifestation, Evidence, Proof” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nujud usually hope their child will grow to embody manifestation, evidence, proof and live with faith, good character and purpose.
